# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://intentius.io/plywood/plywood.schema.json
#
# plywood.yml of the bench's tutor/shop repository (e2e/seed.ts writes it
# before plywood init). dev runs on plunge's record store; staging is a
# stock stack in the same bucket, declared on its stock backend, until
# pw-adopt adopts it and points it at plunge's records (base overlay
# staging-on-plunge); prod-us and prod-eu stay on stock Pulumi. prod-us
# declares the day-2 action rotate, its command resource (e2e/action.ts).
# Every URL is floci as a job on the bench's network sees it.
#
# Every generated job runs in the bench's job image (e2e/bench.ts JOB_IMAGE,
# built by `just e2e image`): plywood from this checkout, the local plunge
# build and stock Pulumi. Without it the jobs get node:22, which has no
# plywood, until a release records the images' digests (plywood#22).
# plywood.yml's check warns that the tag is not a digest; the image is never
# pushed, so there is no digest to pin.
image: plywood-tutorial-job:local
stacks:
  shop/dev:
    dir: .
    backend: plunge+s3://plywood-tutorial-plunge?region=us-east-1&endpoint=http://floci:4566&s3ForcePathStyle=true
  shop/staging:
    dir: .
    backend: plunge+s3://plywood-tutorial-plunge?region=us-east-1&endpoint=http://floci:4566&s3ForcePathStyle=true
  shop/prod-us:
    dir: .
    backend: s3://plywood-tutorial-state?region=us-east-1&endpoint=http://floci:4566&use_path_style=true
    actions:
      - name: rotate
        urn: urn:pulumi:prod-us::shop::command:local:Command::rotate
        description: replace the bench's local command, which writes a marker and touches nothing else
  shop/prod-eu:
    dir: .
    backend: s3://plywood-tutorial-state?region=us-east-1&endpoint=http://floci:4566&use_path_style=true
forge:
  kind: forgejo
  url: http://forgejo:3000
reports:
  url: s3://plywood-tutorial-reports/shop
